## Research status

**Technical owners.** 5 canonical routes.

**Owner routes.** [Adjudicated Persistence and the Adaptive Commit Boundary](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/adjudicated-persistence-and-the-adaptive-commit-boundary.html), [Learning Theory, Generalization, and Scaling Science](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/learning-theory-generalization-and-scaling-science.html), [Policy Optimization and Learning from Feedback](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/policy-optimization-and-learning-from-feedback.html), [Data Engines, Continual Learning, and Unlearning](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/data-engines-continual-learning-and-unlearning.html), [Scientific Discovery and Experimental Governance](https://corbensorenson.github.io/asi-stack-book/chapters/scientific-discovery-and-experimental-governance.html).

**Core support states.** argument.

**Implemented bounded proof targets.** 21.

**Current boundary.** Editorial synthesis does not transfer support among owners and does not establish system-level efficiency, safety, deployment readiness, AGI, or ASI.

**What would change the conclusion.** If competent fixed-locus or human-reviewed policies match decision quality, transfer, deletion, and recovery at lower whole-lifecycle cost, the adaptive commit boundary should be narrowed or retired.

**Technical evidence.** Follow the owner routes above and the live book's claim/evidence registry.
:::
